bio: I build small, fast websites and the tools around them. Before I wrote code, I taught maths, so I still enjoy explaining things simply.
This is a sample portfolio of a fictional person. Replace it with your own story.

projects.title: Tide Tables
projects.description: A tiny web app that shows today's tides for a chosen harbour, built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
projects.problem: Sailors in a small harbour had to read tides from a printed table.
projects.role: I designed and built it alone, in three weekends.
projects.outcome: The harbour club links to it; it loads in under a second on a phone.
projects.stack: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no framework

image.alt: Tide Tables: a blue curve of the tide over a day

projects.aiNote: An AI agent wrote the first chart code; I checked every line and made it accessible.

projects.title: Reading Log
projects.description: A static site that lists the books I read, generated from one JSON file.
